dict.string: FnSpeak listens while you hold the Fn key and turns your speech into text, and transcribes meetings you choose to record. Audio is processed on your Mac and never stored.
FnSpeak learns the names of your contacts so it spells them correctly when you dictate. Names stay on your Mac.

FnSpeak learns meeting titles and attendee names from your calendar so it spells them correctly. If you turn it on in Settings, it also adds a short summary and a link to a recorded meeting's event. Nothing leaves your Mac.
FnSpeak learns meeting titles and attendee names from your calendar so it spells them correctly. They stay on your Mac.
FnSpeak records the audio of calls you choose to transcribe, so the other side appears in the meeting notes. It captures sound only, never your screen, and stores no audio.
FnSpeak creates a note in Apple Notes when you choose Send to Apple Notes.
